solo.name: leaving while a colleague stays on call succeeds
solo.trace:
solo check: leaving while a colleague stays on call succeeds
call: go_off_call(db, doctor_id=1)
schedule choices: []
step 1   R1  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED -> BEGIN
step 2   R1  SELECT shift_id FROM doctors WHERE id = 1 AND on_call = true -> [(1,)]
step 3   R1  SELECT 1 FROM shift_locks WHERE shift_id = 1 FOR UPDATE -> [(1,)]
step 4   R1  SELECT * FROM doctors WHERE shift_id = 1 AND on_call = true -> [(1, 'Alice', 1, True), (2, 'Bob', 1, True)]
step 5   R1  UPDATE doctors SET on_call = false WHERE id = 1 AND shift_id = 1 AND on_call = true RETURNING id -> UPDATE 1 [(1,)]
step 6   R1  COMMIT -> COMMIT
         R1  returned True
invariant ok: every shift has at least one doctor on call
invariant ok: expected state: SELECT array_agg(on_call ORDER BY id) = '{f,t}' FROM doctors
